title: Permissions: View-only gets the same search results; no Inventory View gets 403
custom_preconds:
• Role A: Part Library & Inventory View only.
  • Role B: no Part Library & Inventory View.
  • Untracked parts exist.
custom_steps:
1. As role A, Parts > Inventory, search "not tracked".
  2. As role A replay GET /api/inventory/parts?status=active&search=not%20tracked.
  3. As role B replay the same GET.
custom_expected:
Step 1:

  • The untracked parts are listed, same as for Admin.

Step 2:

  • 200 with the same parts.

Step 3:

  • 403 {"errors":[{"error":"Access denied."}]}
